from collections import Counter
def transform(grid):
    h, w = len(grid), len(grid[0])
    for i, row in enumerate(grid):
        if len(set(row)) == 1 and sum(x == row[0] for r in grid for x in r) == w:
            a, b = grid[:i], grid[i + 1:]
            common = set(x for r in a for x in r) & set(x for r in b for x in r)
            color = next(iter(common))
            return [[3 if x == color and y == color else color for x, y in zip(r1, r2)] for r1, r2 in zip(a, b)]
    for j in range(w):
        c = grid[0][j]
        if all(r[j] == c for r in grid) and sum(r[j] == c for r in grid) == h:
            a = [r[:j] for r in grid]
            b = [r[j + 1:] for r in grid]
            common = set(x for r in a for x in r) & set(x for r in b for x in r)
            color = next(iter(common))
            return [[3 if x == color and y == color else color for x, y in zip(r1, r2)] for r1, r2 in zip(a, b)]
    raise ValueError('separator not found')

code='''def transform(grid):
    h, w = len(grid), len(grid[0])
    sep = next(j for j in range(w) if len({grid[i][j] for i in range(h)}) == 1)
    left = [row[:sep] for row in grid]

code='''from collections import Counter
def transform(grid):
    h, w = len(grid), len(grid[0])
    sep = next(j for j in range(w) if len({grid[i][j] for i in range(h)}) == 1 and j > 0 and j < w-1)

    right = [row[sep+1:] for row in grid]

    candidates = [j for j in range(w) if len({grid[i][j] for i in range(h)}) == 1 and 0 < j < w-1]
    sep = min(candidates, key=lambda j: sum(row[j] == grid[0][j] for row in grid) + sum(row[j] == 4 for row in grid) * 0)
    left = [row[:sep] for row in grid]
    right = [row[sep+1:] for row in grid]

    return [[3 if a == color and b == color else color for a, b in zip(l, r)] for l, r in zip(left, right)]
'''
